name: Cryo / death

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A frozen solid object develops three brittle spreading ice cracks, then a thin crystalline chime as fine frost grains settle. Small intimate ice failure, no big shattering explosion.
